title: Meter Services Standard — Resident-Requested Submeter Tests on the Utility Pass-Through Service
content:
## Clauses

1. A resident may ask for an accuracy test of any submeter on the Utility Pass-Through Service account; there is no meter on the flat-rate schedule and no test is available there.
2. A meter test is taken only on an account that is active, as shown by the account's status in the company's records.
3. A water meter is accurate when its measured deviation is within the schedule's water meter tolerance either way, and a gas, propane or electric meter when within the schedule's energy meter tolerance either way.
4. An accurate meter stays in place and the schedule's meter test fee is charged.
5. An over-registering meter is replaced at no charge, and each regular usage charge for that service in the billing periods within the schedule's over-registration look-back before the test date (but not before the account opened) is credited by the over-billed part — the charge less the charge recomputed at the consumption divided by one plus the deviation — as a meter over-registration credit.
6. An under-registering meter is replaced at no charge, and the unbilled part is back-billed only for the billing periods within the schedule's back-bill limit before the test date, as back-bill usage charges on the current statement.
7. Every recomputed amount is rounded half up to the cent per billing period.

The measured deviation is a percentage: positive when the meter over-registers, negative when it under-registers.

## Outcome by test result

| Test result | Meter | Fee | Correction of past charges |
|---|---|---|---|
| Within tolerance either way | Stays in place | Meter test fee charged | None |
| Over-registering beyond tolerance | Replaced at no charge | None | Each regular usage charge for that service in the look-back periods credited by its over-billed part |
| Under-registering beyond tolerance | Replaced at no charge | None | Unbilled part back-billed for the periods within the back-bill limit, on the current statement |

## Worked over-registration credit (hypothetical, natural gas)

Gas rate 1.182 per ccf; tolerance 2.00 percent; measured deviation 4.00 percent (over-registering, beyond tolerance). One period inside the look-back was billed 52.00 ccf for a charge of 61.46.

1. Consumption recomputed: 52.00 divided by 1.04 (one plus the deviation of 4.00 percent) is 50.00 ccf.
2. Charge recomputed: 50.00 times 1.182 is 59.10.
3. Over-billed part credited: 61.46 less 59.10 is 2.36, for that period. Each other regular gas charge inside the look-back is worked the same way, period by period.

## Points of judgement

- **A test requested on a final-billed account?** Not taken; a test is taken only on an active account.
- **A resident on the Flat-Rate Water, Sewer & Trash Schedule asks for a test?** No test is available; there is no meter.
- **Over-registration found on an account opened eight months before the test?** Credits reach back only to the periods since the account opened, even though the look-back is longer.
